name: Sakuma Itsuki
source:
Hobby/Special Skill: Making Sweets, Foreign Language (English, French)

The main patissier of Cafe Cuillere and the guy the protagonist admires.
He has a warm and kind personality, like he's everybody's big brother.
He actually is [url=/c58003]Asahi[/url] and [url=/c58002]Minato's[/url] older brother.
